# 💍 Assets Directory Guide

Place your media files here:

### 1. 🎥 Wedding Video
- Place your video file named either **`1000138134.mp4`** or **`wedding-video.mp4`** in this folder: `public/assets/1000138134.mp4`
- It will automatically play in the Hero background and in the "Our Beautiful Moments" theater section!

### 2. 👰 Couple Photos
- Bride Photo: `public/assets/bride.jpg`
- Groom Photo: `public/assets/groom.jpg`

### 3. 📸 Gallery Photos
Place your gallery photos in `public/assets/gallery/`:
- `photo1.jpg`
- `photo2.jpg`
- `photo3.jpg`
- `photo4.jpg`
- `photo5.jpg`
- `photo6.jpg`
- `photo7.jpg`
- `photo8.jpg`

### 4. 🎵 Background Music
Place your instrumental wedding song in `public/assets/music/`:
- `wedding-song.mp3`

*(Note: If any photo, music, or video file is not added yet, the website automatically shows beautiful, royal Indian artwork and placeholders without crashing!)*
